描述_EN: the 3ds introduces, as the name suggests, autostereoscopic 3d to portable gaming. the system opens horizontally with two screens at 135° angle from each other, with the lower screen producing a stereoscopic effect without the need for glasses. the 3ds, on the other hand, produces full colour graphics and autostereoscopic effects, has wifi capabilities and portability, which have helped to make it the fastest pre-release selling game console in the uk, and fastest selling games console ever in australia. the nintendo 3ds is the latest (2011) in nintendo's line of portable games consoles, that started with the simple game & watch series from the 1980s to the release of the game boy in 1989, which brought changeable cartridges to portable gaming. nintendo had been developing 3d gaming since the 1980s and had even released a system based on the monochromatic game boy in 1989, called the virtual boy. a market failure, it was quickly removed from nintendo's roster. due to technical limitations it was large and bulky, included a viewing system attached to a console on a stand and projected wired frame graphics in red on a black screen. this is currently the only console to be able to produce this effect, and is in keeping with the late 2000s resurgence of 3-dimensional viewing - in cinemas and in home television sets.
描述_ZN: 3ds引入了，正如它的名字所暗示的那样，自动立体三维技术到便携式游戏。 该系统水平打开，两个屏幕相互成135°角，较低的屏幕产生立体效果，不需要眼镜。 另一方面，3ds产生了全彩色图形和自动立体效果，具有WIFI功能和便携性，这有助于使它成为英国发售前销售最快的游戏机，以及在澳大利亚销售最快的游戏机。 任天堂3ds是任天堂便携式游戏机系列的最新产品（2011年），从20世纪80年代的简单游戏和手表系列开始，到1989年游戏男孩的发布，它为便携式游戏带来了可更换的卡带。 任天堂自20世纪80年代以来一直在开发三维游戏，甚至在1989年发布了一个基于单色游戏男孩的系统，称为虚拟男孩。 市场失败，它很快从任天堂的名册中删除。 由于技术上的限制，它又大又笨重，包括一个连接在支架上的控制台的观看系统，在黑色屏幕上投射红色的有线框架图形。 这是目前唯一能够产生这种效果的游戏机，并且与2000年代末三维观看的复苏相一致--在电影院和家用电视机中。
